question: Different-coloured dustbins are provided by some municipalities in some cities and towns. The blue one is used for collecting _______
solution:
The correct answer is __**reusable wastes.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Reusable wastes:**

 
 
• It** **include items such as** glass bottles, plastic containers, and metal cans** that can be **reused or recycled.**
 
• The **blue one** is used for collecting reusable wastes.
